entries.Original: [AnimSync] Select another player to sync with.
entries.Translated: [AnimSync]选择其他播放器进行同步。

entries.Original: Usage: /animsync [ui|settings|groups|everyone|near|target|pos|align|toggle|body]
entries.Translated: 用法：/animsync [ui | settings | groups | everyone | near | target | pos | align | toggle | body]

entries.Original: [AnimSync] No local player is loaded.
entries.Translated: [AnimSync]未加载本地玩家。

entries.Original: [AnimSync] Select another loaded player to sync with.
entries.Translated: [AnimSync]选择另一个加载的玩家进行同步。

entries.Original: [AnimSync] Both players must finish loading before syncing.
entries.Translated: [AnimSync]两位玩家必须在同步前完成加载。

entries.Original: [AnimSync] One of the current animations is excluded from syncing.
entries.Translated: [AnimSync]当前动画之一被排除在同步之外。

entries.Original: [AnimSync] Join a party to use Time Sync Party.
entries.Translated: [AnimSync]加入小队以使用时间同步小队。

entries.Original: [AnimSync] Target another loaded player to send a time sync tell.
entries.Translated: [AnimSync]瞄准另一个加载的玩家发送时间同步通知。

entries.Original: Auto Sync Anims
entries.Translated: 自动同步动画

entries.Original: How it works:
entries.Translated: 运作方式：

entries.Original: 1. Checks for players near each other within your selected distance.
entries.Translated: 1.在您选择的距离内检查彼此附近的玩家。

entries.Original: 2. Checks that their animations have the same total frames, duration and playback speed.
entries.Translated: 2.检查其动画的总帧数、持续时间和播放速度是否相同。

entries.Original: 3. If they are on different frames, syncs their animations together.
entries.Translated: 3.如果它们在不同的帧上，请将它们的动画同步在一起。

entries.Original: With this enabled, you should rarely need to use animsync manually.
entries.Translated: 启用此功能后，您应该很少需要手动使用animsync。

entries.Original: Sync sound
entries.Translated: 同步声音

entries.Original: Check Refresh Time
entries.Translated: 检查刷新时间

entries.Original: Distance
entries.Translated: 距离

entries.Original: Maximum distance between players for group sync, measured in yalms. Sync Near You uses this radius around you. Adjust it to preview the range circle.
entries.Translated: 组同步的玩家之间的最大距离，以码为单位。同步附近（Sync Near You）会以你为中心使用此半径。调整它以预览范围圈。

entries.Original: Minimum wait before automatically syncing the same players again. At 0, checks run every game update with no added cooldown.
entries.Translated: 再次自动同步相同玩家之前的最短等待时间。在0时，检查运行每个游戏更新，没有额外的冷却时间。

entries.Original: Sync Groups
entries.Translated: 同步组

entries.Original: Syncs nearby groups whose animations have matching frame counts and timing but are on different frames.
entries.Translated: 同步其动画具有匹配帧数和时间但在不同帧上的附近组。

entries.Original: Sync Everyone
entries.Translated: 同步所有人

entries.Original: Restarts all loaded, allowed animations regardless of distance or matching frames. DJ sound exclusions still apply.
entries.Translated: 无论距离或匹配帧如何，重新启动所有已加载、允许的动画。DJ声音排除条款仍然适用。

entries.Original: Sync Near You
entries.Translated: 在您附近同步

entries.Original: Syncs your animation and players inside your Distance radius, without requiring matching frames.
entries.Translated: 在距离半径内同步动画和播放器，无需匹配的帧。

entries.Original: Sync Target
entries.Translated: 同步目标

entries.Original: Syncs only your animation and your selected player's animation, regardless of distance or matching frames.
entries.Translated: 仅同步您的动画和所选播放器的动画，而不考虑距离或匹配的帧。

entries.Original: Sync Position
entries.Translated: 同步位置

entries.Original: Matches your position and facing to your target within 0.5 yalms. With no target, uses the closest player within 0.5 yalms. Unavailable in combat, duties or cutscenes.
entries.Translated: 在0.5 yalms内与你的位置和面向你的目标相匹配。没有目标时，使用0.5 yalms内最接近的玩家。在战斗、任务或过场动画中不可用。

entries.Original: Perfect Frame Sync
entries.Translated: 完美的帧同步

entries.Original: (Experimental)
entries.Translated: (实验性)

entries.Original: Instead of restarting from the beginning, matches the animation frame to the person furthest ahead. Applies to Auto Sync and Sync Groups. Sound playback stays unchanged.
entries.Translated: 将动画帧与最前面的人匹配，而不是从头开始重新启动。适用于自动同步和同步组。声音播放保持不变。

entries.Original: Same time sync
entries.Translated: 同一时间同步

entries.Original: Enable on each participant's client with exactly the same phrase (case-sensitive). Sending the phrase manually or with the buttons restarts animations on each client. Party syncs loaded party members; tells sync you and the other player. The sender waits 300 ms to approximate delivery time; latency varies. Sound and DJ settings apply. Perfect Frame Sync does not apply to this restart.
entries.Translated: 使用完全相同的短语（区分大小写）在每个参与者的客户上启用。手动或使用按钮发送短语会在每个客户端上重新启动动画。参与方同步已加载的参与方成员；告诉同步您和其他玩家。发件人需要等待300毫秒才能大约交付时间；延迟时间各不相同。应用声音和DJ设置。完美帧同步不适用于此重启。

entries.Original: Shared phrase...
entries.Translated: 共享短语...

entries.Original: Enter up to 180 UTF-8 bytes without control characters or chat placeholders (<...>).
entries.Translated: 输入最多180个UTF-8字节，无需控制字符或聊天占位符（ <... > ）。

entries.Original: Time Sync Party
entries.Translated: 时间同步小队

entries.Original: Sends your shared phrase to party chat. Participants need Same time sync enabled with the same phrase.
entries.Translated: 将您的共享短语发送到小队。参与者需要使用相同的短语启用同步。

entries.Original: Time Sync Target
entries.Translated: 时间同步目标

entries.Original: Sends your shared phrase in a tell to your targeted player. Both clients need Same time sync enabled with the same phrase.
entries.Translated: 将您的共享短语发送给目标玩家。两个客户端都需要使用相同的短语启用相同的时间同步。

entries.Original: DJs (Sound Sync Exclusions)
entries.Translated: DJs （声音同步排除）

entries.Original: Keeps DJs music uninterrupted when animations sync. This is only really needed when anim syncing everyone.
entries.Translated: 当动画同步时，保持DJ的音乐不间断。这仅在动画同步所有人时才真正需要。

entries.Original: Search players...
entries.Translated: 搜索玩家

entries.Original: Add target
entries.Translated: 添加目标

entries.Original: Target a player to add them
entries.Translated: 选中玩家以添加他们

entries.Original: Target is already a DJ
entries.Translated: 目标已是DJ

entries.Original: Player
entries.Translated: 玩家

entries.Original: Action
entries.Translated: 操作

entries.Original: (ADD DJ)
entries.Translated: （添加DJ ）

entries.Original: (Remove)
entries.Translated: 移除

entries.Original: No matching players.
entries.Translated: 没有匹配的玩家。

entries.Original: No player identities loaded yet.
entries.Translated: 尚未加载玩家身份。

entries.Original: Wait until you finish loading before syncing position.
entries.Translated: 请等到加载完成后再同步位置。

entries.Original: Position sync is unavailable during cutscenes or GPose.
entries.Translated: 在过场动画或GPose期间，位置同步不可用。

entries.Original: Position sync is unavailable in duties.
entries.Translated: 职位同步在职责中不可用。

entries.Original: Position sync is unavailable during combat.
entries.Translated: 位置同步在战斗中不可用。

entries.Original: No local player is loaded.
entries.Translated: 未加载本地玩家（角色）

entries.Original: Too far — no player is within 0.5 yalms.
entries.Translated: 太远了——没有玩家在0.5码内。

entries.Original: Select another player, or clear your target to find the closest player.
entries.Translated: 选择其他玩家，或清除目标以查找最近的玩家。

entries.Original: Target a visible player, or clear your target to find the closest player.
entries.Translated: 瞄准可见的玩家，或清除目标以找到最近的玩家。

entries.Original: Too far — move within 0.5 yalms of your target.
entries.Translated: 太远—移动到距离目标0.5 yalms以内。

entries.Original: Position sync did not finish. Try again while standing still.
entries.Translated: 位置同步未完成。请站着不动再试一次。

entries.Original: Position synced with
entries.Translated: 位置已与同步
